body:
The code isn't accounting for D3D12 requiring row pitch to be aligned to 256 bytes, but is rather tightly packing everything. That's likely why it's crashing on D3D12.

The crash might be coming from D3D12 backend [aligning the row pitch on its own with the assumption that the buffer is correctly laid out.](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4219ce91f2d1fae65f289d27284a1ab35e9b7b5f/drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp#L4417).
